title: Morusin targets DNA methyltransferase 1 to trigger senescence and sensitizes colorectal cancer to senolytic therapy.
authors: Yang, Peng; Kong, Juanjuan; Li, Xuejia; Lu, Yu; Liang, Gang; Yu, Baofeng; Wang, Hailong; Fu, Rong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Morusin通过结合DNMT1诱导结直肠癌细胞衰老，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作与肿瘤治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inducing tumor cell senescence is regarded as a promising strategy for cancer treatment. However, there is an urgent need for active ingredients that can safely and effectively induce tumor cell senescence and be used in combination with senolytics. Morusin, an isoprenylated flavonoid derived from the Morus alba L. (mulberry), exerts anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and anti-tumor properties. However, the effect of morusin on colorectal cancer (CRC) remains unclear. PURPOSE: To investigate whether morusin can trigger CRC cell senescence and elucidate its potential mechanisms to offer a potential approach for combination therapy with senolytic agents. METHODS: CCK8, EdU assay, colony-formation, cell cycle analysis, calcein/PI staining assay, and SA-beta-Gal staining were conducted to evaluate the suppressive effects of morusin on CRC cells in vitro. Mechanistic investigations were deciphered via molecular docking, network pharmacology, western blot, plasmid construction, cell transfection, molecular interaction assay, biotin affinity pull-down, and ubiquitination analysis. Xenograft mouse models and patient-derived tumor xenograft (PDX) were utilized to evaluate the efficacy of morusin in vivo. RESULTS: We discovered that morusin predisposed CRC cells to cellular senescence. Mechanistically, morusin directly binds to the Q576 site of DNMT1 to facilitate its degradation, subsequently inhibiting the expression of CDK2, and thereby promoting p53 expression. Importantly, morusin exposes the vulnerability of senescent CRC cells to apoptosis resistance, which is selectively eliminated by the senolytic agent ABT263. CONCLUSION: Morusin induces CRC cell senescence via the DNMT1/CDK2/p53 axis, and renders the cells vulnerable to senolytic agents. This study not only broadens the development and utilization of morusin but also provides a novel sequential therapeutic strategy for combating CRC.
abstract_zh: 背景：诱导肿瘤细胞衰老被认为是癌症治疗的一种有前景的策略。然而，迫切需要能够安全有效地诱导肿瘤细胞衰老并与衰老细胞清除剂联合使用的活性成分。Morusin，一种源自桑树（Morus alba L.）的异戊二烯化黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎、抗菌和抗肿瘤特性。然而，morusin对结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）的作用仍不清楚。目的：探讨morusin是否能触发CRC细胞衰老，并阐明其潜在机制，为与衰老细胞清除剂联合治疗提供潜在途径。方法：采用CCK8、EdU实验、集落形成、细胞周期分析、钙黄绿素/PI染色实验和SA-β-半乳糖苷酶染色，评估morusin对CRC细胞的体外抑制作用。通过分子对接、网络药理学、蛋白质印迹、质粒构建、细胞转染、分子相互作用实验、生物素亲和下拉和泛素化分析，揭示其机制。利用异种移植小鼠模型和患者来源肿瘤异种移植（patient-derived tumor xenograft, PDX）评估morusin的体内疗效。结果：我们发现morusin使CRC细胞倾向于细胞衰老。机制上，morusin直接结合DNMT1的Q576位点以促进其降解，随后抑制CDK2表达，从而促进p53表达。重要的是，morusin暴露了衰老CRC细胞对凋亡抵抗的脆弱性，这种脆弱性被衰老细胞清除剂ABT263选择性消除。结论：Morusin通过DNMT1/CDK2/p53轴诱导CRC细胞衰老，并使细胞对衰老细胞清除剂敏感。本研究不仅拓宽了morusin的开发与利用，还为对抗CRC提供了一种新颖的序贯治疗策略。
